scope: Final candidate review for isolated QA and local temporary recovery mocks. No production switch, production database write, or live backup command was performed in this review.

checks: Package member paths, file set, manifest digests, PHP syntax, required notification migration, and existing database tables are checked before apply.
Dry-check exits before maintenance mode, backup, migration, file replacement, permission changes, or service reloads.
Apply enables maintenance and drains existing PHP workers before the backup and migration.
Production restore-check backup is invoked before the additive migrations.
Post-release health first verifies veg_notification_seen exists, then verifies strict-TLS web assets, SPA routing, public APIs, QR configuration, and anonymous API protection.
Health failure restores backend, plugin, web, app configuration, and nginx configuration; the new trees are retained for diagnosis.
Standalone rollback restores the retained code/configuration under maintenance and does not import or modify a database.
release_script_review.database_rollback_policy: The additive payment QR and notification marker schema is preserved by file rollback. Restoring a database is a separate deliberate operation.

isolated_mock_recovery.scope: Temporary local trees only; external MySQL, PHP, backup, nginx, and systemd commands were mocked. Release health was failed by simulating a missing notification marker table. No repository source was rewritten for the mocks.
isolated_mock_recovery.windows_path_note: The in-memory test copy normalized extracted archive path separators to emulate Linux Path formatting; the repository script and package were not changed.

checks.name: dry-check performs no maintenance, backup, migration or service writes
dry-check rejects package missing notification migration
post-migration health rejects missing notification marker table
verified backup restore-check precedes additive migration
backup and all service reloads run under maintenance
health failure restores old code/config and clears maintenance
failed new code is retained in rollback evidence tree
additive notification migration ran before health failure
standalone rollback completes and records restored marker
standalone rollback restores all code trees and app/nginx config
standalone rollback keeps maintenance through checks then clears it
standalone rollback performs no database calls

limitations: Recovery behavior was exercised in isolated filesystem mocks, not by switching the live production service.
A live production backup/restore-check and production deployment remain outside this review.
